steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Gender representation has been a central concern of media studies because media products both reflect and shape cultural attitudes about masculinity and femininity.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Laura Mulvey's 'male gaze' (1975): mainstream cinema positions audiences to view women through a heterosexual male perspective, objectifying their bodies for visual pleasure.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Traditional female stereotypes: damsel in distress, sex object, nagging wife, career woman (as threat), mother/housewife, femme fatale. These reduce complex identities to simple traits.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Traditional male stereotypes: action hero, family man, buffoon (in sitcoms), businessman, villain, lad. Masculinity is often linked to physical strength, stoicism, and control.
